Procurement Manager Job at Thronos Technologies Limited




        
    

        
        Thronos Technologies Limited is the parent company of the Thronos brand ecosystem, established with a broader vision of using technology, innovation, business strategy, and human capital to help organizations operate smarter, perform better, and grow sustainably. At the heart of this vision is a simple belief: great businesses are built at the intersection of technology and people.
     

            
    



Technology provides the systems, intelligence, automation, and digital infrastructure that move modern businesses forward. People provide the leadership, creativity, expertise, culture, and execution that turn those systems into real results. Thronos Alliance is the HR and management consulting arm of Thronos Technologies Ltd, focused on helping organizations build the people, structures, policies, and workplace systems required for sustainable performance.

From talent acquisition and executive recruitment to HR consulting, organizational development, corporate training, performance management, workplace culture, HR policy development, and strategic workforce solutions, Thronos Alliance brings the human side of business into the wider Thronos ecosystem. Together, Thronos Technologies Ltd and Thronos Alliance bridge the gap between technology and human potential.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Procurement Manager will lead strategic sourcing, supplier management, purchasing, contract negotiation and procurement governance to ensure quality, cost efficiency and timely availability of goods and services.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement procurement strategies.
	Manage supplier sourcing, evaluation and selection.
	Negotiate pricing, contracts and commercial terms.
	Manage supplier relationships and performance.
	Develop supplier evaluation and performance frameworks.
	Ensure procurement compliance and transparency.
	Monitor procurement budgets.
	Review purchase orders and procurement documentation.
	Conduct market intelligence and price benchmarking.
	Identify cost-saving opportunities.
	Manage procurement risks.
	Coordinate with Finance, Operations and Logistics.
	Maintain accurate procurement records and reports.


Requirements


	B.Sc Degree / HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics or related field.
	5+ years of procurement experience.
	CIPS/CPSP or other recognized procurement certification is an advantage.
	Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
	Knowledge of procurement regulations and contract management.
	Strong analytical and commercial abilities.
	ERP/procurement software experience is an advantage.


Salary
N300,000 - N400,000 monthly.

HSE Officer Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited - Our client, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HSE Officer

Job Location: Kebbi
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	Our client is seeking a proactive and experienced HSE Officer to support the implementation and maintenance of effective Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards across our operations.


Qualifications & Requirements
     

            
    




	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Environmental Science, Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, or a related discipline.
	3–5 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably within a manufacturing, construction, industrial, or operational environment.
	Relevant professional HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent certifications will be an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of HSE legislation, standards, risk assessment, incident investigation, and emergency response procedures.
	Proficiency in preparing HSE reports and maintaining accurate documentation.
	Good knowledge of workplace safety practices and environmental management principles.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
